scope: Refinement repair of the seven already confirmed findings; no repeat repository-wide discovery.

findings.title: Latest single-file reload owns document data
findings.author: correctness_review
findings.trigger: An older asynchronous read can complete after a newer read and replace its bytes.

findings.title: Entering Edit replaces full-file playback with the selected loop
findings.author: refine_audio_lifetime
findings.trigger: Enter Edit while the original full-file source is already playing.

findings.title: Live display changes preserve playback position
findings.author: refine_audio_lifetime
findings.trigger: Open Live Spec or toggle a level meter after playback has advanced from its cue.

findings.title: Measurement endpoints retain exact boundary samples
findings.author: refine_state
findings.trigger: Integer sample count divided by sample rate then multiplied back rounds below the integer (for example 48005 / 48000).

findings.title: Channel and band monitoring works with analysis panels hidden
findings.author: refine_audio_lifetime
findings.trigger: Select Side or band solo while Live Spec, meters and protection are disabled.

findings.title: Measurement cancellation follows captured inputs and clears status
findings.author: refine_state
findings.trigger: Change layout/mute/view while measuring, or invalidate input during the final cooperative yield.

findings.title: Source-directory export preserves filesystem provider identity
findings.author: correctness_review
findings.trigger: Export beside a source whose URI has a non-file scheme or authority.
